Rank 08 - Service

Tailor and Boutique Order Manager

Measurements, delivery dates, advance payments, and order status are easy to lose in paper notebooks.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 5,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 250Recommended monthly charge

BDT 250/month is acceptable because support burden is lower than restaurant or pharmacy. Cloud backup can be BDT 350/month.

7.5Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 5,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 250Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 8,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target tailoring clusters, ladies boutiques, alteration shops, and Eid-season high-volume businesses. The market is local and fragmented.

Customers ask if the dress is ready. Measurements are misplaced. Delivery promises are forgotten. Advance and due are unclear.

Customer measurements are never lost, and delivery promises are visible every morning.

Validation signals

  • Tailoring is everywhere and seasonal pressure is high.
  • Photo-first order entry reduces typing.
  • Measurements are valuable data.
  • The app can work on one phone.

MVP modules

  • Customer measurement profile
  • Order photo
  • Delivery date
  • Advance and due
  • Work status
  • Staff assignment
  • Pickup reminder

Do not build first

  • Do not build fashion ecommerce.
  • Do not add inventory first.
  • Do not overcomplicate measurement templates.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot before Eid season.
  • Make measurement setup very fast.
  • Print job slips for early users.
  • Use delivery reminder as the retention hook.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Some tailors dislike typing.
  • Seasonal churn after Eid.
  • Different shops use different measurement styles.
Mitigations
  • Use photo-first entry.
  • Offer annual low-price plan.
  • Allow custom measurement labels.
